triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (R1197, 14:5xZ): **p2 · domain:server** → `pm:queue`.

Theme: MCP. Agents save seeds through the build door, and a seed naming no object is accepted. The publish probe then tells the author to "Publish again", which is the wrong fix. In a theme without a direct customer effect, that is p2.

File surface: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` (`seedExternalIdSaveRefusal` / a sibling seed refusal: a seed whose `object` resolves to no pending, draft or registered object), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` + `build-probes.user-text.ts` (the `seed_not_applied` remedy when the object does not exist), the save-door wiring in `protocol.ts` / `protocol-save.ts` only if the refusal needs a new call site, a new test file named for this card (or the shared save-door harness file if AGENTS.md's shared-harness rule applies), root `.changeset/`. ⛔ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (same-area PR #35361 and the queued #34857), ⛔ `packages/spec/**` unless the remedy text must be a spec export (stop and report first). Stop on breach and report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — no path-derived mandate`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Responsibility: platform — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:1048` returns `undefined` ("not judged here") for a seed whose object neither a pending batch, a draft nor the registry knows, so `PUT /api/v1/meta/seed/…` saves it 200; at publish `seedApplied.success` is false and the `seed_not_applied` probe (`build-probes.ts:~549`, cause `unreadable`) tells the author to "Publish again", which cannot work. Reached by every build-door author (MCP agents and REST) who misnames a seed's object.
Thread-read: 6951749983
Premise: holds — on `origin/main` `3819afec`: `seedExternalIdSaveRefusal` skips an unresolved object by design comment ("the load reports an object it cannot find"); a draft object in the same package is still deferred to its publish (`:1043-1046`) and stays so.
Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check.mjs` on a probe branch touching the three files: base clean; open draft PR #35261 (fleet, security/create-objectstack) shares `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` and merges cleanly. The dev re-runs before each push.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol/**`)
Pre-claim deps: none named; #27393 closed (publish stop-at-failure unchanged by design — this card leaves it unchanged).
Prior rulings read: #28990 (save door refuses an unknown permission-set grant — the precedent the card names); #27393 (publish unchanged, out of scope); #28952 (the externalId save refusal this sits beside); check-prior-rulings 384 hits — ADR-0071 §1, ADR-0143 D3, ADR-0150 D9, ADR-0155 D1, ADR-0018 §3 (term noise, none on point); thread: none. Narrowing in lane: dogfood battery on final head, L1-a, seat contract review.
